notFound: us-fiat-500e: no reliable priced factory options located for the base Inspi(RED) trim beyond a zero-cost order package; manufacturer build page returned 403 and spec/review sites (cars.com, carsdirect) had no verifiable paint/wheel/package prices for this trim

us-vinfast-vf-9: VinFast's US site lists exterior color choices and base MSRP ($62,900) but publishes no per-option or per-package pricing for wheels, interior, or packages; no configurator pricing could be verified.

us-maserati-grecale: No source with reliable itemized factory option prices could be found; multiple articles describe price ranges (e.g. 'a few thousand', '$1,500-$3,000') but none ties a specific option name to an exact verified price, and the Edmunds/TrueCar/dealer build pages returned 403 or listing-only content.

us-mclaren-gts: McLaren's official configurator is JavaScript-rendered and returned no readable pricing data; Edmunds build page returned 403; no reputable secondhand source (reviews, dealer listings) was found quoting exact factory option prices for paint, wheels, or packages.

gb-subaru-crosstrek: Crosstrek is not sold new in the UK under this name - only used/imported examples found on Autotrader/Parkers; no UK configurator or official factory options/price list exists to verify against.
